stories.headline: LLMs reward expertise
stories.summary: In the 2010s, if you had technical gaps (say, you couldn’t write CSS), you had to either rely on a skilled colleague or just hope that the answer to your exact problem was out there on the internet.  Today, everyone can write sort-of-okay CSS by delegating the task to an LLM.
